cards.headline: Claude Code is reporting degraded performance
cards.summary: Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls more reliably, and we are monitoring it. It remains enabled for all Enterprise customers. Team customers can again add Claude to new calls manually, and Auto-join is being restored gradually for Team customers.

cards.headline: OpenAI API is reporting degraded performance
cards.summary: We've pushed a fix and are monitoring the recovery.

cards.headline: Tencent: Hy3 down 4 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Hy3 is a 295B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from Tencent (21B active, 192 experts with top-8 routing) built for reasoning, agentic workflows, and real-world production use.

cards.headline: Google: Gemini 4 Carbon up 10 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon is a frontier Gemini 4 model from Google for coding, agentic and complex reasoning work. It takes text, image, audio, video and file input, supports long decode of up to 1M output tokens through continuation, and controls thinking depth with low, medium and high reasoning effort.

cards.headline: Rakazo: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own
cards.summary: Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile.

meta.tagline: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own

cards.headline: OpenAI: GPT-6.1 Terra down 4 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra is the mid-tier model in OpenAI's GPT-6.1 series, priced below GPT-6.1 Sol. It is suited for everyday agentic, coding, and writing work, is particularly strong at understanding screenshots and on-screen content, and is efficient enough for high-volume workloads.

cards.headline: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL down 30 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal mixture-of-experts model from NVIDIA, with 12B active parameters out of 120B total.

cards.headline: Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent: Up to 16 AI Agents That Cross-Check Work
cards.summary: Perplexity added Multiagent to Computer, an effort level above Ultra where a lead agent runs up to 16 agents on Claude, GPT and Gemini models that share findings and check each other’s work.

cards.headline: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4 Flash Latest down 4 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: This model always redirects to the latest model in the DeepSeek V4 Flash family.

cards.headline: Thinking Machines: Inkling 2 Small down 31 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Inkling 2 Small is an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts reasoning model from Thinking Machines Lab, with 17B active parameters out of 594B total. It is the first model in the second Inkling generation.

cards.headline: Frevana Multiplayer: AI that grows your business alongside your team
cards.summary: Frevana runs AI agent apps that find customers, create content, and automate busywork. Now it's multiplayer: invite your team with a link, share agents and skills, and build on each other's work. Your best workflow becomes everyone's.

meta.tagline: AI that grows your business alongside your team

cards.headline: HiringNow: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
cards.summary: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval.

meta.tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.

cards.headline: Latent Lattice Language Models
cards.detail: Shivam Duggal, Zongze Wu, William T. Freeman et al. · cs.LG
cards.summary: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains.

cards.headline: Claude Meetings: Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk
cards.summary: Claude Meetings lets you add Claude to a Google Meet call as a visible participant. The team can ask questions out loud or in chat, and Claude writes the notes and action items so no one on the call has to.

meta.tagline: Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk

cards.headline: Plurai Simulation: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run
cards.summary: Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

meta.tagline: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run

cards.headline: Anthropic leads 7-day GitHub activity (200 events)
cards.summary: anthropics/claude-code — Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.

cards.headline: YouArt Desktop App: Codex for creative team
cards.summary: Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly.

cards.headline: ScroogeFrog AI : AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
cards.summary: ScroogeFrog AI helps advertisers find out where their ad budget is going to waste. It audits website traffic and Google Ads campaigns to uncover suspicious clicks, bot activity, and underperforming spend, then turns complex data into clear recommendations on what to fix.

meta.tagline: AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget

cards.headline: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With a 20% Cheaper Astra API
cards.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol on November 17, 2026. Astra's API price drops 20% to $8/$40 per million tokens, and it ranks second on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

cards.headline: Nod by n8n: Open source personal agent with its own computer
cards.summary: Nod does the work around your work, in your apps and on real websites, using a private computer of its own on your Mac or PC. It takes orders only from you, asks before anything you didn't ask for, and runs on the AI provider you choose. Free, Apache 2.0.

meta.tagline: Open source personal agent with its own computer

cards.headline: Inspiring FOSS project Crosspoint Reader has lessons about tech, communities, and LLMs
cards.detail: Reported by The Register — AI/ML (London, UK).
cards.summary: Cheap tiny e-readers and the perils of LLM-generated drive-by pull requests – plus much more

cards.headline: Nach den Adobe-Klonen: ArtCraft lässt KI auf GitHub-Backlogs los
cards.summary: Hinter den KI-Klonen von ArtCraft steckt ein wachsendes GitHub-Backlog. Das neue Open-Source-Tool AutoCraft soll Issues und Pull-Requests per KI abarbeiten.

cards.headline: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
cards.detail: Huawei Lin, Jinting Liu, Tongyan Wang et al. · cs.CV
cards.summary: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading.

cards.headline: Zu neugierige KI-Agenten: Apple warnt Mac-Nutzer nachdrücklich vor Freigabe
cards.summary: Vielen Nutzern dürfte unklar sein, welch tiefen Einblick sie KI-Apps in macOS erlauben. Neue Apple-Zugriffskontrollen und Warnungen sollen das ändern.

cards.headline: Cloudflare Joins the Jevolution and Labels Itself a Neolab
cards.summary: Cloudflare made its name speeding up the web. Now it's building System One models to make decisions and pull data in milliseconds.

cards.headline: Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction
cards.detail: Ilia Azizi, Frederick Iat-Hin Tam, Marc-Olivier Boldi et al. · cs.LG
cards.summary: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors.

cards.headline: How VLMs Plan What's Next
cards.detail: Rohit Gandikota, Arnab Sen Sharma, Adam Belfki et al. · cs.CV
cards.summary: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts.

cards.headline: Hyperlyve: Parallelized Enumeration and Exact Lyapunov Stability Certification for Deep ReLU Networks
cards.detail: Brian Yarbrough, Jesse Wayment, Jingbo Wang et al. · eess.SY
cards.summary: We introduce Hyperlyve (Hyperplane Partitioned Lyapunov Verification and Enumeration), a framework for proving the asymptotic stability of nonlinear dynamical systems, including those with neural network controllers. Hyperlyve learns and formally certifies continuous piecewise-affine (CPA) neural Lyapunov functions within a counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) loop.
